% Beamer source: the usual title frame with an attribution line after
% \maketitle. Renders fine under Beamer. C-TITLEPAGE records that under ltx-talk
% \maketitle produces a full, vertically-centred frame, so the attribution prints
% ON TOP of the title -- a known 0.5.0 limitation.
%
% ⚠ THAT SYMPTOM DID NOT REPRODUCE (measured 2026-08-24, ltx-talk 0.5.3): this
% exact input compiles clean and renders the attribution BELOW the title block,
% no overlap. Either it was fixed between 0.5.0 and 0.5.3, or the trigger needs
% more than a minimal frame. Re-verify the catalogue entry before filing it
% upstream. The after.tex layout is still a reasonable title frame either way.
\documentclass{beamer}

\title{Constraint Satisfaction}
\author{A. Lecturer}
\institute{University of Somewhere}

\begin{document}
\begin{frame}
\maketitle
\vfill
{\footnotesize Material adapted from Russell \& Norvig.}
\end{frame}
\end{document}
